meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 GitHub 上的代码改动变成一段讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚合并一批改动,想快速录一段讲解给团队或用户看。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a video that explains the code change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just merged changes and want a quick explainer video for your team or users.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能读取一个 GitHub PR 的 diff、提交和文件,写出分帧的讲解方案与脚本,在 HyperFrames 里逐帧搭建,最后渲染出讲解这次代码变更的视频(变更日志、功能亮相、修复或重构)。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或在已检出的仓库里说「这个 PR」时接管。输入必须是代码变更而非网站;意图不明确时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用 acme/sdk#1842 生成变更日志视频,旁白用男声
say.note: 点名声音时会按请求挑选音色

say.text: 就在当前仓库,把「这个 PR」的重构改动讲一遍
say.note: 自动识别当前检出的 PR

howto.what_en: Given a GitHub PR, Claude reads its diff, commits, and files, plans a storyboard and script, builds frames in HyperFrames, and renders a code-change explainer video (changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo. The input must be a code change, not a website; anything unclear routes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: https://github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842
say_en.note: Fetches the diff and commits, then runs the steps

say_en.text: Make a changelog video from acme/sdk#1842, male voice
say_en.note: Named voices are matched when you ask for one

say_en.text: In this repo, walk through the refactor in "this PR"
say_en.note: Picks up the PR checked out here
